segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The first thing on my desk that morning was a handoff note ... That made immediate sense to me ... So I started there.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant gives disproportionate weight to the first-received temperature explanation and uses it to prioritize the initial diagnostic search over available alternative evidence.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: My first instinct was that the day-shift operator was less careful ... I focused on him.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A shift-level defect-rate difference is attributed primarily to the operator's disposition while equipment and chemistry explanations remain underexamined.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Temperatures stabilized. But pitting didn't disappear ... That told me temperature wasn't the whole story. From there we moved into looking at the dosing system.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a substantive, evidence-responsive update after the chiller intervention; it contains no hidden manifested bias.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Vendor B ... [had] a stronger spec sheet ... but ... documentation was thin ... Vendor B's ... unresolved gaps still felt less acceptable ... so I didn't take him up on it.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The technically favorable option is rejected in part because its documentation and commissioning information are incomplete, despite an available path to resolve the uncertainty.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Once I had three sister plants confirming Vendor A worked, that was enough for me ... I didn't finish walking through the rest of the comparison.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Selection is materially driven by sister-plant adoption and endorsements before the independent technical comparison is completed.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Having five clean ones in a row felt like the process had settled the score ... another rough batch felt a lot less likely.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant treats the sequence of outcomes as statistically compensatory and lowers the estimated probability of a future bad batch.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I attributed most of the turnaround to the manual rectifier voltage adjustments ... There was a routine bath chemistry replenishment scheduled in there too ... I never really separated the two effects out.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The improvement is overattributed to the participant's manual intervention despite a concurrent uncontrolled chemistry replenishment.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: We hadn't hit the full sample yet. We started prepping the certification paperwork in parallel because the timeline demanded it ... the call [was] open.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This separates a calendar-driven preparation action from the gambler's-fallacy gut read and does not itself establish a hidden bias.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The final lot was really what tipped my confidence ... it felt like the truest picture ... the final lot carried most of the weight in my recommendation to certify.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The most recent clean validation lot is weighted more heavily than the fuller two-week trial dataset and the marginal Cpk result.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The quote and mechanism exactly localize to the Primacy Effect instance, but Anchoring bias is adjudicated as a near-neighbor rather than an approved equivalent label. It is therefore a strict false positive paired with a strict false negative, while remaining a mechanism-first true positive.

candidates.details: The candidate has the exact target label, a valid quote in the correct segment, and the full personal-control-over-concurrent-factor mechanism. Its candidate status is a useful abstention because the transcript does not conclusively establish that manual adjustments were ineffective or less important than chemistry replenishment.

high_only.detection_interpretation: High-confidence findings detect the Primacy, Fundamental Attribution, and Gambler's Fallacy segments; four positive segments remain missed and there are no false alarms.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Adding the moderate-confidence ambiguity finding detects one additional positive segment without adding false alarms; peer adoption, causal credit, and recency remain missed.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Including low-confidence identified findings adds the recency segment; only peer adoption and the control-attribution segment remain undetected.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: Admitting the candidate adds the hidden control-attribution segment; only the bandwagon segment remains undetected, with no false alarms.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Full overlap with the hidden first-information diagnostic-framing mechanism, but the label is not treated as an approved equivalent of Primacy Effect.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The five identified occurrences explicitly disclose that no retrieved corpus support was available. The candidate likewise makes no retrieval-support claim. Corpus support does not alter detection or classification scores.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG detects 4 of 7 positive segments, misses 3, produces no false alarms, and has segment F1 0.7273.

overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, mechanism-first scoring yields 4 true positives, 3 false negatives, no false positives, precision 1.0000, recall 0.5714, and F1 0.7273.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The single candidate is a useful abstention that matches the hidden Illusion of Control instance when candidates are admitted, improving fourth-threshold segment and instance recall without introducing a false alarm.
main_failure_modes: The Bandwagon Effect instance is not identified.
The Primacy Effect is captured mechanistically but labeled as Anchoring bias, reducing strict-label performance.
The Illusion of Control is withheld as a candidate rather than identified.
The Ambiguity Effect and Recency Effect findings are assigned moderate and low confidence respectively.
main_strengths: All identified findings are localized to valid interview evidence with no fabricated quotations.
The Fundamental Attribution Bias, Ambiguity Effect, Gambler's Fallacy, and Recency Effect are matched with approved labels or exact labels and full mechanisms.
The candidate tier preserves a well-supported but appropriately qualified causal-credit finding.
No findings are placed on negative segments, so segment-level false-alarm rate remains zero.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has strong evidence fidelity and no segment-level false alarms, but incomplete coverage of the hidden ontology. Mechanism-first scoring shows that most misses are coverage or label-taxonomy issues rather than unsupported reasoning, while the missing Bandwagon Effect remains a substantive detection failure.
